python3 - <<'PY'
import limited_client as robot, numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
obs=robot.observe(camera=2); rgb=obs['rgb'].astype(int); dep=obs['depth_m']; K=obs['intrinsic']; T=obs['camera_to_world']
mask=(rgb[:,:,0]>rgb[:,:,1]+12)&(rgb[:,:,2]>rgb[:,:,1]+8)&(rgb[:,:,0]>45)&(dep>0)
lab,n=ndimage.label(mask)
comps=[]
for i in range(1,n+1):
 y,x=np.where(lab==i)
 if len(x)>=4: comps.append((len(x),x.min(),x.max(),y.min(),y.max(),i))
print('components',sorted(comps,reverse=True)[:20])
for size,x0,x1,y0,y1,i in sorted(comps,reverse=True)[:10]:
 y,x=np.where(lab==i); pts=[]
 for u,v in zip(x,y):
  d=float(dep[v,u]); q=np.array([(u-K[0,2])*d/K[0,0],(v-K[1,2])*d/K[1,1],d,1]); pts.append((T@q)[:3])
 pts=np.array(pts)
 print('comp',size,'bbox',(x0,x1,y0,y1),'rgbmed',np.median(rgb[y,x],axis=0).astype(int).tolist(),'depth',np.percentile(dep[y,x],[10,50,90]).round(3).tolist(),'worldmedian',np.median(pts,axis=0).round(4).tolist())
 for v in sorted(set([y0,(y0+y1)//2,y1])):
  sel=np.abs(y-v)<=1
  print(' row',v,'x',int(np.median(x[sel])),'d',round(float(np.median(dep[y[sel],x[sel]])),3),'xyz',np.median(pts[sel],axis=0).round(3).tolist())
print('status',robot.status())
PY
